mechanism: Irbesartan may increase loperamide levels through CYP3A4 inhibition, potentially elevating CNS and cardiac effects; loperamide can also cause fluid retention opposing irbesartan's antihypertensive action.
action: Monitor blood pressure control and watch for signs of loperamide toxicity (dizziness, constipation, abdominal distention); consider alternative antidiarrheal agents if possible.
